---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = fct_rev(month))) +
  geom_density_ridges() +
  labs(
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
